ruleDefinitions.name: NTFS Alternate Data Stream
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects writing data into NTFS alternate data streams from powershell. Needs Script Block Logging. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*set\\-content.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*add\\-content.*")) AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-stream.*"))
